upgrades.name: Port Cannon I
upgrades.description: Add one cannon to your port broadside.

upgrades.name: Starboard Cannon I
upgrades.description: Add one cannon to your starboard broadside.

upgrades.name: Port Grapeshot
upgrades.description: Unlock a separate port control firing three slower, heavy shots in a wide fan. Reloads independently.

upgrades.name: Port Cannon II
upgrades.description: Add one more port cannon. Requires Port Cannon I.

upgrades.name: Starboard Grapeshot
upgrades.description: Unlock a separate starboard control firing three slower, heavy shots in a wide fan. Reloads independently.

upgrades.name: Starboard Cannon II
upgrades.description: Add one more starboard cannon. Requires Starboard Cannon I.

upgrades.name: Port Powder Crew
upgrades.description: Your port grapeshot crew fires automatically when an enemy enters its broadside arc.

upgrades.name: Starboard Powder Crew
upgrades.description: Your starboard grapeshot crew fires automatically when an enemy enters its broadside arc.

upgrades.name: Master Gunner
upgrades.description: The final ship upgrade. Unlock automatic primary broadsides after buying every cannon and grapeshot upgrade. Can be toggled in settings.
